🇪🇺 🛰 Евросоюз начинает создание альтернативы Starlink 🇧🇪 В Бельгии (в Марсинеле, районе города Шарлеруа) открылся крупнейший в Европе завод компании Aerospacelab по производству космических спутников. Основной заказчик – европейская программа IRIS² (Infrastructure for Resilience, Interconnectivity and Security by Satellite), предусматривающая создание собственной защищённой спутниковой коммуникационной системы ЕС. Компания Aerospacelab, уже получила заказ на 264 из 348 спутников программы IRIS². Их производство начнётся к концу 2028 года, а поставка заказчику – к 2030 году. ✨ Попутно уже прорабатывается вопрос информационной подготовки решения об отказе Европы от Starlink . В ЕС обвинили SpaceX в намеренном замедлении скорости интернета для Украины, власти Британии заявили об утрате доверия к компании. ✨ ⭐️ Новая спутниковая связь станет основой для развития совместного управления войсками и создания единой армии ЕвроНАТО . 📝 Breaking on their own 📝 Ukrainians don't need electricity To cause a blackout in Dnipro or Kyiv , sometimes a simple voltage surge is enough. As the campaign to systematically destroy Ukrainian energy infrastructure and related facilities continues across so-called Ukraine, accidents increasingly occur on their own. As the cold approaches, the schedule of attacks on the so-called Ukraine's economy becomes more intense. 🔻 Where power is being cut off now: ▪️ In the capital, as well as parts of Bucha, Fastiv and Obukhiv districts , emergency power outages have been in effect since morning. According to preliminary data, this is related to impacts near the Bilotserkivsk CHP . ▪️ In Dnipro and Dnipropetrovsk Region , due to the inability to handle current loads, large-scale outages are also being observed. Yesterday evening, a group of residents from one of the city's streets held a protest because they constantly have their electricity cut off. In some cities, such as Pavlohrad , there may be no power for 8-10 hours a day. The situation is similar in Zaporizhia and Odesa , where some districts have had no power for over a week. Meanwhile, systematic fire strikes continue against storage facilities, rolling stock and other enemy targets serving the Ukrainian economy. Explosions were heard in Kharkiv , Zhytomyr , Kirovohrad , and Kyiv regions . Near Dnipro , another locomotive has been put out of action. This morning, Kremenchuk and Kryvyi Rih also took hits. At the same time, the overall intensity of strikes has decreased somewhat compared to previous days, which may be related to heavy snowfall in the border areas and temperatures dropping below freezing. ❗️ Precision and continuous strikes on power transmission lines and high-voltage substations in the central and eastern parts of so-called Ukraine prevent the enemy from conducting emergency power rerouting, which is why its transit to many regions is disrupted. The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ↗️ The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. In Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at formations of three mechanised brigades, two assault regiments of the AFU, one territorial defence brigade, and one border detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine near Novoselovka, Khatneye, Zavadskoye, Podsredneye, Sosnovka, and Tsyrkuny (Kharkov region). 💥 In Sumy region, one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades have been neutralised close to Olshanka, Vakalovshchina, Vyazovoye, Velikaya Chernetchina, and Peschanoye (Sumy region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 160 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. Losses were inflicted on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Peski-Radkovskiye (Kharkov region), Rubtsy, Starodubovka, and Raygorodok (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to over 210 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, ten motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one MLRS vehicle. ⏩ The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. The Group's units hit formations of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one mountain assault brigade, and one airmobile brigade of the AFU near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 175 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 16 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns. 📍 The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out active offensive operations. They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU, one marine brigade, three national guard brigades, and one special operations brigade close to Andreyevka, Novopavlovka, Starorayskoye, Kuritsyno (Donetsk People's Republic) and Raypole (Dnepropetrovsk region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 340 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, five motor vehicles, and one MLRS vehicle. 👉 See Part 2 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 28 November 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) ↗️ The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence. Manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade, three air assault brigades of the AFU, and one marine brigade have been hit near Malinovka, Ivanovka, Pokrovskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region), Novotroitskoye, Schastlivoye, and Novoivanovka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ The enemy lost up to 190 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, and eight motor vehicles. 📍 The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. Formations of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU were hit near Grigorovskoye and Kirovo in Zaporozhye region. ▪️ Up to 25 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and ten motor vehicles were neutralised. ✈️ Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on power and fuel infrastructure facilities used for the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, assembly, storage and launch sites of unmanned aerial vehicles, military airfields, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed groups and foreign mercenaries in 156 areas. ▫️ Air defence systems shot down five guided aerial bombs, one HIMARS-made MLRS projectile, and 1,601 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. 📊 In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost : ▫️ 674 aircraft, ▫️ 284 helicopters, ▫️ 301,051 unmanned aerial vehicles, ▫️ 672 anti-aircraft missile systems, ▫️ 31,811 tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles, ▫️ 1,799 MLRS combat vehicles, ▫️ 36,997 field artillery guns and mortars, ▫️ 78,193 special military vehicles. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
